images.caption: Figure 1:Overview of DecoupleMix.(a) Recipe search:annotated datasets are optimized along two decoupled axes—inter-class budget allocation and intra-class convex selection—then validated and scaled up on a cheap proxy model (2.5B→\rightarrow10B tokens).(b) Dynamic admission:a new dataset is evaluated under thefixedconfiguration, turning its acceptance into a controlled, attributable integrate-or-reject decision.
